Initial processing of loaded data. Please select whether MBR has been switched on during the data processing in DIA-NN and you are starting with the main report after the search against the project specific library generated during the search, or whether the MBR was switched off or you are using first-pass report from the search where the MBR was switched on. This will adjust the columns to be filtered the report on.%%00010%%00010First, lower quality peptides are filtered out based on the q or PEP thresholds set. Next, precursors are pivotted on the stripped sequence level and further grouped to get to the protein group (PG) level using maximum values for all intensity columns and minimal values for all types of q-values. The total quantity sum is calculated for every PG and peptide from all samples used later on for sorting.%%00010%%00010PG level table represents the first output of this metanode, the second one is the table on the stripped peptide sequence level.%%00010%%00010The third output of this metanode are individual sample names.
